name: Divine VIP Shop
changelog:
### Added
- Resizable UI for every player, not just admins. A `-` / `+` control in the shop's
  topbar lets each player scale the whole tablet UI between 70% and 130%.
- The chosen size is saved locally per player (via a client-side KVP) and is
  restored automatically the next time they open the shop, including after a
  server restart.
